response.sql: WITH item_stats AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_item_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count FROM item_stats;

assumptions.assumption: A line item's ratio is undefined when derived_total_cost is NULL or zero, so it is treated as missing and skipped in the per-item average. Items with no line items or only missing ratios get a NULL average and are ignored in the final average.
COUNT(ili.order_item_id) counts only matched invoice line items, so an order item with no line items gets a count of 0 and is still included in the average of counts.
